faq.question: Which plans include store translations?
faq.answer: Store translations are included with Pro and Premium. Automatic translation uses AI credits from your account.

faq.question: Which languages are supported?

faq.question: Are automatic translations free?
faq.answer: Automatic translation uses AI credits from your account. Reviewing and saving your own edits does not run the translation AI.

faq.question: Does this rewrite my store files?
faq.answer: No. Translations are stored separately and applied when shoppers view your store.

faq.answer: No. Describe your store and ask for changes in plain words. Estori builds the pages, and you review them in the live preview.

faq.answer: Ask Estori to change a layout, add a section or refresh your product copy. Preview the changes before publishing.

faq.question: Can I sell products I make myself?
faq.answer: Yes. Add your own products with photos, descriptions and prices. You handle shipping for those products.

faq.question: How do shoppers pay?
faq.answer: Set up payments and connect your Stripe account. Shoppers pay at your store’s checkout, and payouts go to your bank.

faq.answer: Customers choose a plan at checkout. Their payments repeat on the plan’s schedule, so they do not need to place a new order each time.

faq.question: How do customers manage their subscriptions?
faq.answer: Subscribers can skip, pause, swap or cancel from their account in your store, without needing to email you.

faq.question: Can I customize how my plans are presented?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask Estori to build plan pages that explain your options, compare what is included and help customers choose.

faq.question: What can I share with my community?
faq.answer: Share posts, lessons, events, recordings and downloads. Give members a place to ask questions and talk with each other.

faq.question: Can I offer free and paid memberships?
faq.answer: Yes. Create a free space to welcome your audience and a paid space with extra content, resources or perks.

faq.question: How does my community connect to my store?
faq.answer: Your community lives alongside your products and shares the same customer list. Keep shopping and membership together under your brand.

faq.question: Can I include downloads for members?
faq.answer: Yes. Offer e-books, templates, videos and other resources as part of joining your community.
